company.shortDescription: KULI is a travel arrangement services company that connects passengers with coolies.
company.description: KULI provides service ensuring a seamless experience for passengers. Prior to arrival at the station, passengers simply input their station, platform, and coach details, and their chosen porter will be ready and waiting. Additionally, with GPS tracking, the safety of luggage is guaranteed, eliminating the risk of theft.
